name: car_speed
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Blender modeling reference sheet for an Android top-down 3D racing game.
Subject: A high speed circuit coupe, long low wedge nose, wide low stance, rear wing, bright red body. Slower acceleration and larger turning radius expressed by a long wheelbase.
Style: coherent low-poly miniature motorsport, flat polygon surfaces, simple opaque materials, easy to reproduce as real low-poly geometry. Clean off-white background, soft studio illumination.
Composition: One vehicle design shown consistently in a large front three-quarter view plus smaller orthographic top, side and front views. Wheels and body silhouettes clearly readable.
Constraints: no real brands, no text, no watermark, no photoreal textures, no motion blur, no excessive details. Modeling reference, not game screenshot.
